question: ¿Qué tres empresas de la industria, como sponsor principal, acumulan más ensayos terminados o retirados (detenidos) de cáncer de pulmón?

attempts.query:
SELECT sp.name
FROM aact.sponsors sp
JOIN aact.studies s ON s.nct_id = sp.nct_id
WHERE sp.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead'
  AND sp.agency_class = 'INDUSTRY'
  AND s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED', 'WITHDRAWN')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions bc
              WHERE bc.nct_id = s.nct_id AND bc.downcase_mesh_term = 'lung neoplasms')
GROUP BY sp.name
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT s.nct_id) DESC
LIMIT 3
